status: specified; full scheduler integration not implemented by reference kernel
window: W=(max(0,now_tick-1800),now_tick], with explicit tick0 bootstrap events included once in first window

phases.rule: Advance exactly one active tick. Accrue service revenue and operating cost for [t-1,t) at the old contract/rate. Age cohorts, queues, invoices and conditions. Suspended sessions advance zero ticks.

At the timestamp: refill monthly market pools; update quarter competition; activate paid deployments; attempt due customer collections; settle irrevocably committed funding receipts. Never sample when merely reading metrics.

Compute all six rates from one pre-work snapshot, including prior strain_backlog and context_rot. Founder focus cardinality <=1. Acquire input reservations in (created_tick,id) order; spend affordable variable attempt cost before execution.

Resolve earned whole attempts using stable per-function attempt cursors. Split homogeneous cohorts for partial outcomes. Commit failures/rework, successes, contract changes and actual Ops maintenance exactly once. Emit outputs to downstream queues with available_tick=t+1.

Commit actual next rot/strain and customer health. Resolve dated churn threats after same-timestamp rescue work. Create new threats only for customers without an open threat. Expire unresolved opportunities; no expiry penalty on non-opportunity maintenance jobs.
Issue monthly arrears invoices from earned unbilled service. Generate operating bills and anniversary loan interest/principal bills; unique IDs prevent forecast/bill duplication.
Pay due bills ordered by (due_tick,id). Failure at first unpaid mandatory bill when cash is insufficient. Then check accepted VC mandate. Cash=0 alone is not failure. A timestamp may not be skipped.
Aggregate eligible ARR and the rolling window, rebuild dated cash forecast, compute valuation, then award first successful $1B checkpoint only if phase 7 survived.

Accept affordable optional purchases, routing changes, new financing decisions and quarter-shop selections. Their effects start no earlier than t+1. Inspection, finance and shop use founder attention; background simulation continues.
Publish one immutable metric snapshot with version, tick and event cursor; record replay hash. Rendering must not mutate inputs or consume random draws.

clock.attention_seconds_delta: tick_seconds to exactly one of work, inspection, finance, shopping, idle when active; 0 otherwise

upgrade.guard: 0 <= selected_axis_rank < 4 and cash_cents >= 30000 * 6**selected_axis_rank and no pending upgrade for same axis
upgrade.configuration_changes: +1 on each activated rank, changed mode, changed target/routing policy, changed verification policy or changed provider exposure; continuous throttle/founder focus changes add 0

queue.attempt_accounting: attempt_credit += available_rate_per_second * 0.1; whole=floor(attempt_credit); debit only executed whole attempts; clamp stored residual to [0,1) when no eligible work remains; no idle stockpile
queue.reservation: reserve min(remaining eligible items, floor(craft_batch * max(luck_outcomes(rank)) + batch_credit)) per production attempt; release unattempted reservation; only actual domain attempts consume items
queue.expiry: expire opportunities at created_tick+300; churn threat at created_tick+120; process permitted same-tick work first; maintenance/development jobs have null expiry
queue.overflow: accept first capacity items; reject excess with dropped_count telemetry; rejected output creates no ARR or refund

demand.input: selected channel pool; one attempted reach consumes one remaining person from that channel month
demand.cost_per_attempt_cents: channel.cost_per_attempt_cents (replaces generic demand attempt_cost, does not add to it)
demand.segment: inverse CDF of channel.segment_weights using one stable seeded draw per consumed person
demand.success: one qualified opportunity to Product.activate; expiry now+300

product.develop: each useful output increases selected capability by 0.02, clamp [0,1]; domain probability 1; stop when capability=1
product.bad_ship: per successful development attempt, escaped_defect_probability draw; on true add 0.05 to defect_exposure of every active cohort, clamp [0,1]
product.activate: consume qualified opportunities, probability customer.activation_probability; success creates activated trial in Monetisation.sell, expiry now+300
product.fix: domain probability 1; each useful output removes 0.02 defect_exposure from one selected cohort, clamp >=0

monetisation.price: founder-selected integer cents/month, >=1; same posted monthly subscription model across segments
monetisation.success: create active payer cohort at selected price, health=70, addons=0, age=0; ARR increases 12*price; earned revenue and cash increase 0 at signing
monetisation.reprice: new posted price affects new contracts only; existing changes are voluntary accepted renewal offers sampled once per billing anniversary with the same paid_conversion_probability; rejection keeps old price; retention concession uses its separate rule

retention.threat_count: Binomial(active_count - at_risk_count, churn_probability_step), independent per origin_account_id and tick
retention.deadline: threat_tick+120; each customer has at most one open threat
retention.save: sample once per targeted open threat using save_probability; success closes threat and health=min(100,health+10); failure leaves dated threat but marks it attempted so that threat cannot be retried
retention.concession: on successful save only, new price=max(1,floor(old_price*(10000-save_discount_bps)/10000)); this is contractual contraction, not a one-time cash refund
retention.care: domain probability 1, one output covers one customer for 600 ticks; care_coverage=covered_count/count; no stacking above 1
retention.expiry: cancel unsaved affected contracts at deadline, including addon ARR; no new revenue or cash for a save

expansion.price: floor(base_monthly_price*.25) per slot; reject zero-priced addon
expansion.success: consume one eligible slot and add one addon to one customer; split cohort; ARR increases 12*addon_price; earned revenue/cash unchanged at signing
expansion.repricing: addon price recomputes from accepted current base price; bridge includes base and addon deltas

operations.maintain: N useful output points; each function gets N * ops_maintenance_weight; accumulated strain receives N * strain_repair_share; sum of all seven weights <=1; unused output discarded
operations.incident: one useful output reduces selected cohort incident_exposure by .02; incident-mode output does not also create maintenance points

failures.rework: +1.5 work units per technical failure, including failures in Ops
failures.service: consume min(backlog, raw_service_capacity*rework_share*dt) rework work; does not award production output; costs resources; rework does not recursively spawn another rework job
failures.escaped_incident: one escaped_defect_probability roll per technical failure; if true, +.05 incident_exposure on affected cohort, clamp<=1; demand/product develop failures with no target use segment pool of current active cohorts; never invent a direct score penalty

billing.model: monthly in arrears; one subscription; no annual prepay or deferred revenue in candidate
billing.earned: divmod(monthly_contract_cents*elapsed_ticks+remainder,600); carry remainder, accrue old rate before mutation
billing.invoice: at activation_tick+600*k, issue accrued unbilled cents; AR increases, unbilled decreases, earned and cash unchanged
billing.collection: due=invoice_tick+segment.collection_delay_ticks; at each of at most 3 attempts use segment.collection_probability; success collects full outstanding, reduces AR and raises cash; next failed attempt=previous+120; after third, next_attempt_tick=null
billing.delinquency: max(0,now-min(unpaid_due_ticks+unresolved_default_due_ticks)) per cohort, or 0 when both sets empty; score eligibility removed only when >1200; cash receipt may restore eligibility while contract remains active
billing.bad_debt: unpaid receivable remains until explicit writeoff; no automatic new cash. Writeoff reduces AR, books bad-debt expense once and persists unresolved_default_due_tick as the earliest written-off due date. This marker prevents writeoff from restoring score eligibility. Candidate forbids further credit sale to that origin account.

payments.variable_work: deduct whole-cent cost per started attempt from prepaid cash; if unaffordable, throttle attempt to zero rather than fail an optional action
payments.operating_accrual: COGS=customer service + Product/Retention/Expansion work and attributable upkeep. Opex=Demand/Monetisation/Ops work/upkeep + base overhead + explicit bad debt. Classify once. Acquisition tagging is a report subset, never an additional debit.
payments.upkeep: accrue from actual online_units and active auto rank each tick; bill all unpaid accrued cents at next company month boundary; throttling utilization to 0 does not remove upkeep, taking unit offline does
payments.mandatory_order: receipts before due bills at identical tick; bill tie break by stable ID; interest and principal separate; cash shortfall at due timestamp is terminal
payments.forecast: 1800-tick dated prefix; current contracts/rates only, no new sales/upgrades/funding. Include existing invoices plus invoices due from scheduled service, forecast each invoice once at its next attempt with probability*0.8 haircut; no extra forecast retries. Add booked unpaid bills plus future unbilled service/upkeep by unique period ID, scheduled debt, accepted refunds and committed purchase liabilities. Include only already irrevocably committed capital receipts. First negative prefix defines runway risk.

debt.terms: 18% nominal APR, six monthly anniversary payments, no prepayment in candidate
debt.failure: unpaid scheduled debt service uses same cash-failure rule; no debt-linked growth target

vc.guard: eligible_ARR>=1200000; one active priced round in candidate
vc.offer: pre_money_cents=4*eligible_ARR; maximum_raise=floor(pre_money*.25); accepted amount integer cents in [1,maximum_raise]
vc.mandate: deadline=accept_tick+1800; required_ARR=ceil(baseline_ARR*1.5) when baseline>=1200000, else 1200000; below target at deadline is terminal VC failure
vc.renew: on meeting target: baseline=current_eligible_ARR; deadline+=1800; no automatic new cash
vc.score: capital cash can improve dated payment coverage; financing never directly adds ARR or overwrites company valuation

success.once: first_unicorn_tick recorded once; successful_runs+=1 once; relic_award_eligible=true
success.failure: failed_runs+=1 once; no new permanent relic power; already owned relics remain owned
success.rerun: initial_cash=apply_modifiers(150000,'starting_cash',owned_relic_modifiers); do not normalize difficulty against founder wins; specific achievements/effects deferred

function.window_useful_output_count.source_writer: sum task.useful_output_count in W filtered by function_id and work mode

function.window_domain_attempts.source_writer: sum actual consumed domain inputs in W filtered by function_id and work mode

function.window_attempt_cost_cents.source_writer: sum committed variable work charges in W filtered by function_id

function.window_dropped_output_count.source_expression: sum downstream-capacity rejection counts in W filtered by source function_id
function.window_dropped_output_count.source_writer: sum downstream-capacity rejection counts in W filtered by source function_id

function.window_expired_input_count.source_expression: sum unresolved dated input counts expiring in W filtered by function_id
function.window_expired_input_count.source_writer: sum unresolved dated input counts expiring in W filtered by function_id

function.founder_work_seconds.source_writer: tick_seconds * count active founder-work ticks assigned to function_id

customer.delinquency_ticks.source_expression: max(0,now_tick - min(unpaid_due_ticks + unresolved_default_due_ticks)); 0 when both sets empty
customer.delinquency_ticks.source_writer: max(0,now_tick - min(unpaid_due_ticks + unresolved_default_due_ticks)); 0 when both sets empty

company.window_open_arr_cents.source_expression: eligible_ARR snapshot after all phases at max(0,run.tick-1800); at tick0 opening ARR=0

company.window_new_arr_cents.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for subscribe events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_expansion_arr_cents.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for positive_contract_delta events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_contraction_arr_cents.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for negative_contract_delta events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_churn_arr_cents.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for cancel events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_eligibility_loss_arr_cent.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for exclude_delinquent events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_eligibility_restore_arr_c.source_expression: sum eligible ARR delta magnitude for restore_eligible events in W; count each delta in exactly one bridge bucket

company.window_revenue_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of earned_service_revenue events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_cogs_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cost_accrual[cogs] events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_opex_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cost_accrual[opex] events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_interest_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of loan_interest_accrual events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_collections_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of customer_collection events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_operating_payments_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cash_payment[cogs or opex] events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_refund_payments_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cash_refund events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_install_payments_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of upgrade_install_payment events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_principal_payments_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cash_payment[principal] events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.window_cash_interest_cents.source_expression: sum signed cents of cash_payment[interest] events in W; financing receipts excluded

company.largest_exposure_arr_cents.source_expression: max(sum(eligible_ARR grouped by origin_account_id),default=0); cohort splitting does not diversify an account

company.window_new_payers.source_expression: count distinct origin accounts first becoming paid in W

company.matched_acquisition_cost_cents.source_expression: sum attribution-ledger costs for the origin accounts first becoming paid in W, including pre-W acquisition work

company.opening_cohort_arr_cents.source_expression: sum contractual ARR at W start for then-active origin accounts

company.opening_cohort_churn_arr_cents.source_expression: sum B_i for opening origin accounts whose closing contractual ARR R_i=0; B_i is that account's ARR at W start

company.opening_cohort_contraction_arr_c.source_expression: sum max(0,B_i-R_i) for opening origin accounts with R_i>0; net closing contraction, not all transient negative events

company.opening_cohort_expansion_arr_cen.source_expression: sum max(0,R_i-B_i) over opening origin accounts; net closing expansion, not all transient positive events

reference_ledger_scope: Financial transaction examples assume all cohorts are score-eligible and homogeneous; full adapter must supply eligibility, cohort splitting, scheduler, cost ledger and outcome-based invoice linkage per this contract. Ledger.arr() is contractual ARR, not the production scoring adapter.
rng: SHA256 compact JSON [str(seed),str(stream),str(event_id)], top53 bits / 2**53; stream names isolate technical/domain/local/shared/churn/collection; stable attempt cursor must never reset when a task is rebatched; persist full IDs with seed and profile hash.
